items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Whose idea was it for you to sing? Was it yours or it was Rudi Blesh, Conrad Janis...? [INTERVIEWEE] Rudi Blesh.

ctx.x: In New York in 1947. We don't have the record at the Institute of Jazz Studies. It's a broadcast, and it's on the Kings of Jazz label. I'll see if I can...
That wasn't with Rudi Blesh, was it?
